name: File Browser
description: Simple web file manager for one folder you choose: browse, upload, download, share and edit files. Upstream was archived in 2026-09; v2.63.23 is the final release.
deprecationNote: The File Browser repository was archived on 2026-09-01: no further releases or security fixes. Keep it local or behind authentik/Cloudflare Access, and prefer Nextcloud or HFS for anything exposed.

volumes.name: files
volumes.description: The one folder File Browser shows (read-write).

inputs.label: Folder to manage
inputs.help: Only this folder is visible and writable in File Browser. Choose a dedicated folder, never a whole drive or a system folder.

security: File Browser can delete and overwrite everything in the chosen folder: choose a dedicated folder.
Its admin password is random and printed once in its log on first start; change it immediately.
Unmaintained upstream: no security fixes after v2.63.23.

notes: No apps or API clients: a sign-in gate (authentik or Cloudflare Access) in front of it works well.

limitations: Archived upstream: no further releases or security fixes.
Folders on Windows drives are accessed through Docker Desktop file sharing and are slower than Docker volumes.
manualSetup: Read the generated admin password: docker compose logs app (look for "randomly generated password"), sign in as admin and change it.

update.notes: No newer versions will be published.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, own API, network isolation, modular stack, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
